Select compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure availability. Join docs on doc_id to obtain PubMed ID and DOI. Filter for target CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism.
